diagnosis.effect: The frozen robust-z implementation used max(1e-12, 1.4826*MAD), so a quantized zero-MAD metric can create extremely large finite z-scores. The parent population result is therefore retained but not promoted as calibrated utility evidence.

posthoc_audit_rule.per_radius: Exclude any metric from standardized aggregate scoring when its same-radius control MAD is exactly zero.
posthoc_audit_rule.controls: same RNG seed and same generation rules
posthoc_audit_rule.population_tests: same 5000-iteration radius-matched permutation and same one-sided Mann-Whitney secondary test
